# life-principles — what good looks like for personal-life work

> **One rule:** open the principle file of the kind of work before you start, and judge the finished work against it. A principle says what good is and why; how-to lives in the skills, order and roles in the playbooks. The 3-layer idea and the principles for every job are in `superuser:work-principles`.

## Kind of work → principle → skills → playbook

| Kind of work | Principle file | Main skills (full list in each file) | Main playbooks |
|---|---|---|---|
| Life admin (documents · bills · home · vehicle · moving · travel · flood · accounts) | [`references/life-admin.md`](references/life-admin.md) | `family-legal` · `household-money` · `home-upkeep` · `travel-prep` · `digital-hygiene` | `documents` · `bills` · `subscriptions` · `maintenance` · `vehicle` · `trip` · `digital-safety` |
| Health organising (no diagnosis, no dosing) | [`references/health-care.md`](references/health-care.md) | `health-admin` · `family-care` | `doctor-visit` · `medication-routine` · `checkup-cycle` · `care-setup` |
| Career | [`references/career.md`](references/career.md) | `job-search` · `career-growth` | `job-application` · `interview` · `offer-negotiation` · `promotion-case` · `profile-refresh` |
| Learning | [`references/learning.md`](references/learning.md) | `learning-path` · `thesis-writing` · `personal-kb` | `learning-path` · `paper-to-practice` · `cert-prep` |
| Teaching (workshop · training · online course · tutoring) | [`references/teaching.md`](references/teaching.md) | `course-builder` | `teach-a-course` |
| Planning (week · goals · habits · tasks · meetings · inbox · decisions) | [`references/planning.md`](references/planning.md) | `weekly-review` · `goals-and-decisions` · `meeting` | `weekly-reset` · `decide-and-goals` · `habit-tracking` · `meeting` |
| Family home (school · meals · gifts · family calendar) | [`references/family-home.md`](references/family-home.md) | `family-care` · `family-week` | `family-week` |
| Family legal (wills · inheritance · disputes; no legal advice) | [`references/family-legal.md`](references/family-legal.md) | `family-legal` | `documents` |
| Tech growth (side projects · keeping up) | [`references/tech-growth.md`](references/tech-growth.md) | `tech-growth` | `side-project` · `tech-radar` |

Every job also follows `superuser:work-principles` (prove it works · small steps · simple · root cause · human writing · sources).

## Adding a kind of work

1. Write `references/<work>.md` in the same format: `งานดีคืออะไร` (6–8 principles, each with why + how a reviewer checks it) · `พลาดบ่อย` · `ใช้คู่กับ` · sources.
2. Each principle needs at least 3 reliable sources that agree; drop it otherwise.
3. Add 1 row to the table above.

## Check before done

- The principle file for this kind of work was opened before starting, and the reviewer judged against it
- No step order or `ใคร:` went into a principle file; no how-to was copied into a playbook
